ns2:section.sectionText: DIGITAL RECORDING AND EDITING SOFTWARE TECHNIQUES FOR MUSIC EDUCATORS 2 HOURS CREDIT This two-week course is designed as an introductory class to offer music educators information and initial hands-on experience with digital audio recording/editing software for improving the quality of recordings of your ensembles, master recording preparation and rehearsal disc preparation for your classroom and ensemble needs. Appropriate digital transfer to CD-R will also be addressed. All course participants will be assigned lab times and will work directly with the equipment and programs.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Music Education or Music or Musicology major(s).
